# `FluxRuntimeHost::set_cell_material`

<span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge-ABI">ABI</span> <span class="sdk-kind">method</span>

Source: **ABI v4** (`src/plugins/abi.rs`). Generated group: **Methods**.

## Description

Sets one editable world cell to the requested stable material id.

## Signature

```rust
fn set_cell_material (& mut self , cell : UVec2 , material_id : & str) -> Result < () , FluxStatus >
```

## SDK Example

_Source: [`examples/methods/fluxruntimehost-set-cell-material.md`](../../examples/methods/fluxruntimehost-set-cell-material.md)_

```rust
fn paint_metal(host: &mut FluxRuntimeHost, cell: UVec2) -> FluxStatus {
    match host.set_cell_material(cell, "flux.default.cell.metal") {
        Ok(()) => FluxStatus::OK,
        Err(status) => status,
    }
}
```
